brief:
An Israeli minister has called for the settlement of the entire West Bank, Al Jazeera English reported. The statement comes amid ongoing Israeli military operations in the occupied territory.

Israeli forces are conducting raids on Palestinian homes across the West Bank and converting them into interrogation centres, according to the outlet. The raids mark an intensification of military activity in the occupied Palestinian territory.
dek: Israeli forces are raiding Palestinian homes in the occupied West Bank and turning them into interrogation centres.
title: Israeli minister calls for settling entire West Bank
